item.title: रामानुजीय-प्रभावः
item.description:
The earliest famous one was around 1059CE . Some of his works were later completed by another of the same name, who post dates vedanta Desika - M

shrInivAsa-makhin’s commentary on BS and BG (quoted bits available) seem eerily similar to rAmAnuja’s commentaries. It makes one wonder who “borrowed” from whom. Based on citations and impact, it seems more reasonable to assume that rAmAnuja was the earlier commentator. Also, considering the styling of shrInivAsa makhin as “vedAnta deshika”, he seems to postdate vedAnta deshika as well.
